etymology: perhaps from the base of 5494 in the sense of its congener the base of 5490 (through the idea of hollowness for grasping)
definition:
1) by the help or agency of any one, by means of any one
 2) fig. applied to God symbolising his might, activity, power
    2a) in creating the universe
    2b) in upholding and preserving (God is present protecting
        and aiding one)
    2c) in punishing
    2d) in determining and controlling the destinies of men
